integrity: Proof and direct finite enumeration supplied; comparison-based originality assessment is limited to examined sources. Independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd primes and exponent-p Heisenberg groups only. Counts labelled abelian-image group endomorphisms, not brace or Yang--Baxter isomorphism classes. Earlier literature already covers unrefined rank counts. Possible older equivalent refinements have not been conclusively excluded.
title: Joint fixed-point and image-size census of abelian endomorphisms of finite Heisenberg groups
